# Prosper or Perish - Noble investment: nobles with surplus gold build peasant and labourer buildings for goods
# their markets are short of, the most profitable first.
# Generated by scripts/generate_noble_investment.py from the built mod's building types. Do not edit by hand.
# 137 candidates.

# Country scope. Fired by monthly_country_pulse (on_action/pp_noble_investment.txt).
pp_noble_investment_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = pp_noble_investment_cooldown }
			country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
			"estate(estate_type:nobles_estate)" = { estate_gold >= pp_noble_investment_reserve }
		}
		"estate(estate_type:nobles_estate)" = { save_scope_as = pp_noble_investment_nobles }
		set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_best_score value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_best_index value = 0 }
		pp_noble_investment_find_best = yes
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:pp_noble_investment_best_index > 0 }
			scope:pp_noble_investment_location = { pp_noble_investment_build_best = yes }
			set_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_cooldown value = 1 days = 90 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_cooldown value = 1 days = 180 }
		}
	}
}

# Location scope helpers for the profit of one building at one location (all in local variables).
# A block starts with no method.
pp_noble_investment_start_block = {
	set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_block_profit value = -1000000 }
	set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_block_revenue value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_block_cost value = 0 }
}

# Keep the method just computed when it makes more than the block's best so far.
pp_noble_investment_keep_better_method = {
	set_local_variable = {
		name = pp_noble_investment_method_profit
		value = { value = local_var:pp_noble_investment_method_revenue subtract = local_var:pp_noble_investment_method_cost }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:pp_noble_investment_method_profit > local_var:pp_noble_investment_block_profit }
		set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_block_profit value = local_var:pp_noble_investment_method_profit }
		set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_block_revenue value = local_var:pp_noble_investment_method_revenue }
		set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_block_cost value = local_var:pp_noble_investment_method_cost }
	}
}

# Add the block's best method to the building's revenue and input cost.
pp_noble_investment_add_block = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:pp_noble_investment_block_profit > -1000000 }
		change_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_revenue add = local_var:pp_noble_investment_block_revenue }
		change_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_cost add = local_var:pp_noble_investment_block_cost }
	}
}

# The building at this location becomes the best candidate when it makes more than the best so far (which starts at
# 0: it must make money) and earns at least the AI's margin on its inputs.
pp_noble_investment_keep_better_location = {
	set_local_variable = {
		name = pp_noble_investment_profit
		value = { value = local_var:pp_noble_investment_revenue subtract = local_var:pp_noble_investment_cost }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:pp_noble_investment_profit > local_var:pp_noble_investment_best_score
			local_var:pp_noble_investment_revenue >= {
				value = local_var:pp_noble_investment_cost
				multiply = pp_noble_investment_min_margin
			}
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_best_score value = local_var:pp_noble_investment_profit }
		set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_best_index value = $index$ }
		save_scope_as = pp_noble_investment_location
	}
}

# Country scope: the most profitable candidate's index (local_var:pp_noble_investment_best_index), its profit per
# level (local_var:pp_noble_investment_best_score) and location (scope:pp_noble_investment_location).
pp_noble_investment_find_best = {
	# 1: alum_quarry (laborers, alum)
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_advance = advanced_mining
			scope:pp_noble_investment_nobles = {
				estate_gold >= {
					value = building_type:alum_quarry.building_base_cost_in_gold
					multiply = pp_noble_investment_price_multiplier
					add = pp_noble_investment_reserve
				}
			}
			any_market_present_in_country = { "goods_demand_in_market(goods:alum)" > "goods_supply_in_market(goods:alum)" }
		}
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				exists = market
				market = { "goods_demand_in_market(goods:alum)" > "goods_supply_in_market(goods:alum)" }
				pp_unemployed_population >= pp_noble_investment_min_unemployed
				can_build_building = building_type:alum_quarry
			}
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_revenue value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_cost value = 0 }
			pp_noble_investment_start_block = yes
			# pp_alum_quarry_base_alum
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_revenue value = { value = "market.market_price(goods:alum)" multiply = 0.08 multiply = { value = 1 add = modifier:local_alum_output_modifier } } }
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_cost value = { value = 0 add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:manual_labor)" multiply = 0.048 } } }
			pp_noble_investment_keep_better_method = yes
			pp_noble_investment_add_block = yes
			pp_noble_investment_start_block = yes
			# pp_alum_quarry_no_secondary
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_revenue value = { value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_cost value = { value = 0 } }
			pp_noble_investment_keep_better_method = yes
			# pp_alum_quarry_clay
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_revenue value = { value = "market.market_price(goods:clay)" multiply = 0.264 multiply = { value = 1 add = modifier:local_clay_output_modifier } } }
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_cost value = { value = 0 add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:lumber)" multiply = 0.045 } add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:tools)" multiply = 0.005 } add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:manual_labor)" multiply = 0.022 } } }
			pp_noble_investment_keep_better_method = yes
			# pp_alum_quarry_stone
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_revenue value = { value = "market.market_price(goods:stone)" multiply = 0.168 multiply = { value = 1 add = modifier:local_stone_output_modifier } } }
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_cost value = { value = 0 add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:lumber)" multiply = 0.066 } add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:tools)" multiply = 0.007 } add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:manual_labor)" multiply = 0.028 } } }
			pp_noble_investment_keep_better_method = yes
			pp_noble_investment_add_block = yes
			pp_noble_investment_start_block = yes
			# pp_alum_quarry_no_primary
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_revenue value = { value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_cost value = { value = 0 } }
			pp_noble_investment_keep_better_method = yes
			# pp_alum_quarry_alum
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_revenue value = { value = "market.market_price(goods:alum)" multiply = 0.424 multiply = { value = 1 add = modifier:local_alum_output_modifier } } }
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_cost value = { value = 0 add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:lumber)" multiply = 0.3 } add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:tools)" multiply = 0.05 } add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:coal)" multiply = 0.14 } add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:manual_labor)" multiply = 0.21 } } }
			pp_noble_investment_keep_better_method = yes
			pp_noble_investment_add_block = yes
			pp_noble_investment_start_block = yes
			# pp_alum_quarry_market_sales
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_revenue value = { value = "market.market_price(goods:alum)" multiply = 0.004 multiply = { value = 1 add = modifier:local_alum_output_modifier } } }
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_cost value = { value = 0 add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:offset)" multiply = 0.012 } } }
			pp_noble_investment_keep_better_method = yes
			pp_noble_investment_add_block = yes
			pp_noble_investment_keep_better_location = { index = 1 }
		}
	}

	if = {

			pp_noble_investment_keep_better_method = yes
			pp_noble_investment_add_block = yes

			pp_noble_investment_keep_better_method = yes

			pp_noble_investment_start_block = yes
			# pp_alum_works_no_primary

			# pp_alum_works_alum
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_revenue value = { value = "market.market_price(goods:alum)" multiply = 0.672 multiply = { value = 1 add = modifier:local_alum_output_modifier } } }
			set_local_variable = { name = pp_noble_investment_method_cost value = { value = 0 add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:lumber)" multiply = 0.36 } add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:tools)" multiply = 0.08 } add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:coal)" multiply = 0.25 } add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:lead)" multiply = 0.1 } add = { value = "market.market_price(goods:manual_labor)" multiply = 0.25 } } }
			pp_noble_investment_keep_better_method = yes

			pp_noble_investment_keep_better_method = yes

	if = {

				limit = { owner = { has_advance = slitting_mills } }

# Location scope (the chosen location): the nobles start the chosen building there.
pp_noble_investment_build_best = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:pp_noble_investment_best_index = 1 }
		construct_estate_building = { building_type = building_type:alum_quarry estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:pp_noble_investment_best_index = 2 }
		construct_estate_building = { building_type = building_type:alum_works estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:pp_noble_investment_best_index = 3 }

	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:pp_noble_investment_best_index = 4 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { local_var:pp_noble_investment_best_index = 5 }

	}

	}
	else_if = {

	else_if = {

	else_if = {
